content.user_title: Search Metix Jobs and Research Hiring Demand
content.value_statement: Hiring research requires consistent filters and complete job records. This skill guides Metix AI searches using the live contract, paginated identifiers, and batched detail retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Build job filters from the live contract using supported fields, operators, and salary currency requirements.
Search job postings and follow cursor pagination to collect matching job identifiers.
Retrieve posting records in batches of up to 100 job identifiers.
Select returned fields and retrieve employer records through company identifiers.
Interpret API error codes and consult linked Markdown documentation.
Use the METIX_KEY environment variable for authentication and stop when it is missing.
limitations: Authenticated requests require a valid METIX_KEY and access to the external Metix service.
Available fields, operators, and limits depend on the live API contract.
Search responses return identifiers, so complete postings require separate detail requests that can consume API Credits.
Email and phone requests belong to metix-people-search; this skill does not provide contact unlocking.

use_cases.title: Find relevant openings
use_cases.description: Search active postings by role and supported location or salary criteria, then retrieve the fields needed for a shortlist.

use_cases.title: Research employer hiring
use_cases.description: Retrieve matching job records and resolve company identifiers to inspect the employers behind relevant openings.

use_cases.title: Compare hiring demand
use_cases.description: Compare matching posting totals across supported role or seniority filters while keeping date windows and pagination consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Find recent roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 data engineer postings from the past 30 days on Metix. Return titles, posting dates, and company names.

prompt_templates.title: Apply salary criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the live contract, then find software engineer roles with a supported annual salary minimum of USD 120,000. Return relevant salary fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: apply contract-valid salary filters with an explicit currency.

prompt_templates.title: Research hiring employers
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recent product manager postings. Retrieve job and company identifiers, then fetch employer details by company ID. Batch requests and report missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect job results to employer records.

prompt_templates.title: Compare role demand
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare data engineer and analytics engineer postings from the past 30 days. Confirm filters and credit usage with me before pagination and batched retrieval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: plan a consistent comparison with controlled API usage.

output_examples.output: Search paused: METIX_KEY is not set. Configure it in your environment before continuing. Do not paste the key into the conversation.

output_examples.input: Explain the expected result structure for a recent data engineer search.
output: Expected search response: matching job identifiers, a total count, and a next-page cursor when more results remain.
Expected detail response: the selected posting fields, such as title, posting date, company identifier, and company name.
This is a workflow preview, not a live search result.

output_examples.input: Get a hiring contact email from these job postings.
output_examples.output: Contact details require the separate metix-people-search capability. This job-search workflow does not unlock email addresses or phone numbers.

best_practices: Read the live contract before building filters, and include an explicit currency with salary comparisons.
Batch detail requests and review credit documentation before retrieving large result sets.
Keep METIX_KEY in the environment and exclude it from files, logs, and summaries.
anti_patterns: Inventing filter fields or assuming search responses contain full posting records.
Retrieving one job identifier per detail request or exceeding the 100-identifier batch limit.
Searching the machine for substitute credentials or printing the API key.

faq.question: What do I need before searching?
faq.answer: You need access to Metix and a valid METIX_KEY environment variable for authenticated requests. The live contract requires no key.

faq.question: Does a search return complete job postings?
faq.answer: No. Search returns job identifiers. Retrieve complete records through the detail endpoint in batches of up to 100 identifiers.

faq.question: How are salary filters handled?
faq.answer: Use operators allowed by the live contract. Annual salary comparisons require a currency equality or membership filter in the same condition group.

faq.question: How do I retrieve employer information?
faq.answer: Include company.id in the job detail projection, then use those identifiers with the company detail endpoint.

faq.question: Can this skill retrieve contact emails or phone numbers?
faq.answer: No. The instructions direct contact requests to metix-people-search and its contact unlocking capability.

faq.question: Do requests consume API Credits?
faq.answer: Result retrieval can consume API Credits in result bands. Consult the live credit documentation and batch requests to manage usage.
